safe_bridge_rule: The existing reference implementation must determine the complete result within its declared supported scope.
Every resulting TerraBattleState mutation target must be explicit.
All ordering, lifetime, target, scheduler, callback and event dependencies must close before private candidate construction.
Unknown packet fields or unresolved dependencies must block before state, RNG, allocator, revision, queue or trace publication.

capability_matrix.session_gap: No complete action binds all stat reads and modifier effects to a Terra step.
Reference team SP and M5 synthetic resource transitions are separate; M5 is ineligible as M10 closure proof.
Damage commits to an immutable reference state, but no complete selected player action supplies its full effect and completion closure to Terra.
The source-backed Natasha HOT example is a modifier phase callback, not a selectable ordinary action.
Shield absorption is bounded reference settlement only; no complete battle action is bridged.
Selected stance components are reference executable with explicit context; full action and break dependencies must still close.
Selected lifecycle operations do not establish the complete callback graph for a battle action.
An explicit operation target may resolve, but manual action admission and automatic secondary target closure remain separate.
The query validates supplied proposals; it does not discover a complete source-backed action set from an actor or ability.
Ordinary recharge requires a completed SUCCESS action task; no qualifying damage action proves that marker and all intervening effects. Pending inserted or special arbitration remains unresolved.
Caller-supplied proposal cost and exact reference packet debit are independent until one complete action binds them.
A REF02 TASK_MARKER is isolated and cannot imply complete action-task success or callback/event closure.
Reference alive and HP values exist; official death, revive and downstream event effects are not inferred.
Only explicit custom left/right alive counts can be evaluated; no official Stage result or death-count fallback is licensed.
An AI opportunity does not choose or authorize a player action or enemy behavior.
